Has a smartphone to attack enemies with.

hair is now a ponytail and no longer has a scarf.

Black goggles with ten dots on each eyes, jacket is now dark blue, backpack now has two antennae.

Purple veins around body and one blue vein on the left arm.

Dark blue wings.

Extended arm-bands.

Longer hair.

Blue on the clothes is now slightly purple.

Loincloth has moved back again.

Even more blue and purple veins.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001A-QINU`"'

Dark blue halo.

Face is covered by dark blue wings.

Light blue outlines on arm-bands.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001B-QINU`"'

Blue wings around legs.

Grey spikes on the tablet, blue on the tablet is now also darker.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000001C-QINU`"'

Gold skin, blond hair, neon yellow crying eyes, gold vest, arm-bands, belt, pants and shoes, and neon yellow left arm.

Fires at enemies using a tablet flying above its head, from which it fires gray beams from.

Holograms are colored yellow.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000023-QINU`"'

Gold crown and shoulder-pads.

Hair color changed from blond to grey.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000024-QINU`"'

Gold wings and cloth around waist.

Extended arm-bands.

Longer hair.

Right arm is now neon yellow.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000025-QINU`"'

Gold halo.

Face is covered by gold and grey wings.

Dark gold outlines on arm-bands.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000026-QINU`"'

Dark skin, black hair, grey tank top, brown cap, black belt, blue pants and brown shoes.

Camera equipment backpack with a projector on top.

Holds a radio in its left hand.

Wields a camera to attack enemies, from which it fires beams with yellow-orange hue film reel effect from.

Holograms are colored white with yellow shinning effect on them.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000002E-QINU`"'

Radio on torso.

Grey headphones.

Wires at the bottom of the backpack.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000032-QINU`"'

Piloted by an elf that wears a green jacket, brown pants and shoes, and a red Santa hat.

Beams have green mist effect.

Holograms are colored white.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000039-QINU`"'

Bells on antlers, bigger red nose and additional armor.

Pilot now wears goggles and red armbands.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000003A-QINU`"'

Rounder mech arms.

Pilot now wears a bron bandolier, bell around neck and has a Santa hat with a white pattern.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000003B-QINU`"'

Bigger antlers.

Pilot now wears a brown bandanna.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-0000003C-QINU`"'

Pale skin, yellow side-tail with pink hairband, cyan shirt white vest with text that says "I LOVE (HATE) SUMMER" on it, yellow jacket with the text "NEMU" on it, black pants and orange sandals.

Has a cellphone to attack enemies with.

Holograms are colored yellow.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000044-QINU`"'
Pink pearl bracelet on right hand and orange and yellow armband on left hand.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000045-QINU`"'
Jacket is now tied around waist, revealing the blue sleeves which have "ZEN8" written on the left one.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000046-QINU`"'

Cyan scuba goggles with pink visor and breathing pipe.

Shirt now has a yellow, wave-like pattern at the end of its sleeves.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000047-QINU`"'

Green and yellow shoulder-pads, green yellow swimming tube with pink stars and pink and blue spike balls on side-tail.

Now has a floating plush of the skin with a white and blue swimming tube.'"`UNIQ--nowiki-00000048-QINU`"'
